roots.beginner_clue: A dragon's eye turns toward the Chime; an egg rocks once.
roots.advanced_uses: Name the dragon-kind as an Aim (WYRM NEAREST, WYRM HOSTILE, SELF WARD WYRM); made, it is a dragon's weight.
roots.interactions: Your own dragon is mended, not struck; a stranger's tamed dragon is not yours to touch.
roots.meaning: The dragon-kind: found, any dragon of Wyrmroost (and its eggs); made, the weight of a wyrm that throws a creature back and slows it, or mends one of your own.

roots.arpabet: HH EH S P AA N
roots.beginner_clue: A resting dragon folds its wings as the Chime nears.
roots.advanced_uses: WYRM ROOST toggles your dragon between rest and readiness; a GREATER clause lays it to sleep; on a wild dragon it buys a few seconds of hesitation.
roots.interactions: A roused dragon answers FOLLOW and SUMMON; a stranger's tamed dragon ignores it; it is a no-op on anything that cannot roost.
roots.meaning: Settle: sit your own dragon (or pet) down where it is, or rouse one already at rest; a wild dragon hesitates, forgetting its quarry for a while.

elder.arpabet: D R AA K AA N
elder.meaning: Dragon's breath: a hot, far-reaching flame that bursts wide and sets the ground around it alight. Costs one more CP.
elder.beginner_clue: A Royal Red's breath leans toward the Chime.
